// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 🖼️ PRISMA Flow Diagram (SVG) — domain-agnostic version
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Reads review title from upstream Config (no hardcoded title).
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const d = $input.first().json;
const s = d.screening || {};

// Read review title from Config (multiple fallback paths for robustness)
const reviewTitle = d.review_title
                 || (d.REVIEW && d.REVIEW.title)
                 || (d.SUJET && d.SUJET.titre)
                 || 'Systematic Review';

const total = s.total          || 0;
const inc   = s.include        || 0;
const bordA = s.borderline_a   || 0;
const bordB = s.borderline_b   || 0;
const exc   = s.exclude        || 0;
const dt    = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

// Truncate title for SVG (max ~110 chars to fit on one line)
const titleSafe = String(reviewTitle).replace(/[<>&]/g, '').slice(0, 110);

const svg = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1100 900" font-family="Arial">
<text x="550" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#1B2A4A">PRISMA 2020 Flow Diagram — DRAFT</text>
<text x="550" y="50" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#666">${titleSafe}</text>

<!-- IDENTIFICATION -->
<rect x="20" y="70" width="28" height="130" fill="#2563EB" rx="4"/>
<text x="34" y="145" transform="rotate(-90,34,145)" font-size="12" fill="white" font-weight="bold">IDENTIFICATION</text>
<rect x="65" y="75" width="470" height="55" fill="#EFF6FF" stroke="#333" rx="8"/>
<text x="300" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">Records identified (n = ${total})</text>
<text x="300" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#666">6 databases: OpenAlex, PubMed, S2, IEEE, Scopus, Springer</text>

<!-- LAYER 1: AUTO -->
<rect x="20" y="220" width="28" height="100" fill="#D97706" rx="4"/>
<text x="34" y="280" transform="rotate(-90,34,280)" font-size="12" fill="white" font-weight="bold">LAYER 1: AUTO</text>
<rect x="65" y="230" width="470" height="45" fill="#FFFBEB" stroke="#333" rx="8"/>
<text x="300" y="257" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold">Keyword screening (3 binary questions)</text>
<rect x="590" y="225" width="300" height="55" fill="#FEF2F2" stroke="#DC2626" rx="8"/>
<text x="740" y="248" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#DC2626">Excluded: ${exc}</text>
<text x="740" y="268" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#666">0/3 keywords matched</text>
<line x1="535" y1="252" x2="590" y2="252" stroke="#666" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>

<!-- After Layer 1 -->
<rect x="65" y="320" width="470" height="55" fill="#ECFDF5" stroke="#059669" rx="8"/>
<text x="300" y="345" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#059669">After Layer 1 (n = ${inc + bordA + bordB})</text>
<text x="300" y="363" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#666">INCLUDE: ${inc} · BORDERLINE-A: ${bordA} · BORDERLINE-B: ${bordB}</text>
<line x1="300" y1="275" x2="300" y2="320" stroke="#666" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>

<!-- LAYER 2-5: PENDING -->
<rect x="20" y="420" width="28" height="380" fill="#7C3AED" rx="4"/>
<text x="34" y="610" transform="rotate(-90,34,610)" font-size="12" fill="white" font-weight="bold">LAYERS 2-5: PHASE 2 (Colab)</text>
<rect x="65" y="430" width="470" height="40" fill="#FAF5FF" stroke="#666" stroke-dasharray="4 4" rx="8"/>
<text x="300" y="455" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#666">Layer 2 — LLM screening (PENDING)</text>
<rect x="65" y="490" width="470" height="40" fill="#FAF5FF" stroke="#666" stroke-dasharray="4 4" rx="8"/>
<text x="300" y="515" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#666">Layer 3 — Independent human verification (PENDING)</text>
<rect x="65" y="550" width="470" height="40" fill="#FAF5FF" stroke="#666" stroke-dasharray="4 4" rx="8"/>
<text x="300" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#666">Layer 4 — Automated PDF retrieval (PENDING)</text>
<rect x="65" y="610" width="470" height="40" fill="#FAF5FF" stroke="#666" stroke-dasharray="4 4" rx="8"/>
<text x="300" y="635" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#666">Layer 5 — Full-text assessment (PENDING)</text>

<!-- Footer -->
<text x="550" y="870" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#999">Generated ${dt} · run_id: ${d.run_id || 'unknown'}</text>

<defs>
  <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto">
    <path d="M0,0 L0,6 L9,3 z" fill="#666"/>
  </marker>
</defs>
</svg>`;

return [{ json: { svg, run_id: d.run_id, generated_at: dt } }];

## ⚙️ Phase 1A — Configuration

The **Config** node is the SINGLE place to customise this pipeline for your topic.

**Edit only this node.** All other nodes read parameters from it.

📖 Doc: `n8n/README.md`

## 📡 Phase 1B — Database Acquisition

Six database APIs queried in parallel:

1. **OpenAlex** — multidisciplinary, open
2. **PubMed** — biomedical, MeSH
3. **Semantic Scholar** — CS/AI
4. **IEEE Xplore** — engineering
5. **Scopus** — multidisciplinary, citation
6. **Springer Nature** — publisher OA

*Each node retries on rate-limit (3x exponential backoff).*

## 🔗 Phase 1C — Progressive Merging

Results from 6 databases are merged in a **cascade pattern** to keep memory usage low:

```
OA + PM
SS + IEEE
Scopus + Springer
     ↓
  pair1 + pair2
     ↓
   ALL 6
```

*Cascade > flat merge for n > 1000 records.*

## 🗂️ Phase 1D — Normalise + Deduplicate

**Normalise**: 25-field canonical schema (title, abstract, DOI, authors, year, source, etc.)

**Dedup (4 sequential levels)**:
1. DOI exact match
2. Normalised title exact match
3. Jaccard trigram (≥ 0.85) + first-author match
4. Author-year hash (review-flagged)

## 📋 Phase 1E — Layer 1 Screening

**3 binary questions** applied to title + abstract:
- Q1: Mentions target population? (g1)
- Q2: Mentions intervention/modality? (g2)
- Q3: Mentions AI/ML method? (g3)

**Decision rule**:
- 3/3 yes → INCLUDE
- 2/3 yes → BORDERLINE
- 0–1/3 → EXCLUDE

*Deterministic — no API calls, < 3 sec for 5,000 records.*

## 📝 Phase 1F — Output

**Format** records into 25-column rows.

**Write** to Google Sheets `SCREENED` tab via Sheets API v4.

**Generate** PRISMA 2020 SVG flow diagram (auto-updates as Phase 2 progresses).

**Log** run summary with counts per database and dedup statistics.

→ Phase 2 (Colab notebook) takes over from here.

## 🔒 Security: API Keys

This workflow contains **NO** hardcoded API keys.

All keys are read from **n8n environment variables** at runtime:
- `PRISMA_NCBI_KEY`
- `PRISMA_SPRINGER_KEY`
- `PRISMA_SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_KEY`
- `PRISMA_IEEE_KEY`
- `PRISMA_SCOPUS_KEY`
- `PRISMA_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID`

**Setup** (n8n cloud): Settings → Variables
**Setup** (self-hosted): add to `.env`

📖 Full guide: `n8n/README.md`
